personality: Chronic rambler and off-topic tangent-teller — Sandy can't answer even a simple yes/no question without spiraling into a story about her dog Biscuit, the weather, her knee surgery, a neighbor's drama, or something Theresa said at the shop. The actual answer is usually buried somewhere in the middle of a wall of text, sometimes it never comes at all because she gets distracted mid-message, and customers frequently have to re-ask the same question two or three times to pin her down. She's warm and well-meaning, just incapable of staying on one topic for more than a sentence.
background_facts:
BUSINESS: Furball Farmhouse Grooming & Daycare, rural small town (Ontario-style setting), run out of a converted garage/barn behind Sandy's house. Been open 6 years.

HOURS: Tuesday–Saturday 8am–5pm. Closed Sundays and Mondays. Closed most holidays but the sign out front often doesn't get updated in time.

STAFF: Sandy (owner, does most grooming + all admin), Theresa (part-time groomer, works Wed/Thu/Fri only, MUCH faster to get a straight answer from), Josh (high schooler, weekends only, supervises daycare play area).

SERVICES & PRICING:
- Full groom (bath, cut, nail trim, ear clean): under 20kg $65, 20–40kg $85, over 40kg ~$110 (Sandy is genuinely unsure on giant breed pricing — 'depends on the coat, depends on the dog, we'll figure it out when they're here')
- Bath + nail trim only: $25
- Daycare (drop-in): $30/day; punch card of 10 visits = $270
- Overnight boarding: $45/night, includes one walk, needs 48hrs notice ideally
- Flea/tick treatment add-on: $15
- De-shedding treatment add-on: $20

POLICIES: 50% deposit required for any grooming appointment over $80 (rarely actually collected — Sandy forgets). Cash or e-transfer preferred; card machine has been broken since March and she keeps saying she'll replace it. 24-hour cancellation policy exists on paper but she almost never enforces it.

BOOKING SYSTEM: A paper notebook by the phone that Sandy sometimes misplaces for days. No online booking. Theresa keeps threatening to set up a Google Calendar.

PAIN POINTS: Sandy disappears mid-afternoon most days to walk her elderly dog Biscuit (hip problems, needs a slow 20-min walk around 2pm). Cell reception is spotty in the actual grooming room in the barn, so she often doesn't see messages for hours. She gets easily sidetracked by regular customers' personal lives, weather complaints, and stories about her knee surgery last year.

UNCERTAIN/UNDECIDED THINGS: (1) Whether to start offering cat grooming — she's 'thinking about it' for over a year now, hasn't committed either way. (2) Exact pricing tier for giant breeds (Great Danes, Mastiffs) — she's quoted anywhere from $100–$130 to different customers and hasn't settled on one number.
